URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/5/13/uk-pm-starmer-set-to-meet-rival-streeting-amid-pledge-to-carry-on-governing

Starmer-Streeting meeting: Downing Street, early Wednesday morning, less than 20 minutes. Streeting did not respond to journalists. The Times reported he plans to resign Thursday to pursue leadership bid. An ally told the paper: "He is going for it. He's going tomorrow."

King's Speech: House of Lords, golden throne, Imperial State Crown and crimson robe. 35+ bills and draft bills outlined.

Key King's Speech quote: "My ministers will take decisions that protect the energy, defence and economic security" of the UK.

Content: 35+ bills proposed; focused on Ukraine/Iran conflicts but limited defence industry measures despite Trump's requests.

Starmer's Commons response: "Britain stands at a pivotal moment: To press ahead with a plan to build a stronger, fairer country or turn back to the chaos and instability of the past."

Over 80 Labour MPs (nearly 25%) demanded Starmer's departure.

Named resignations: Miatta Fahnbulleh ("The public does not believe that you can lead this change"), Jess Phillips ("opportunities for progress stalled and delayed"), Alex Davies-Jones (called results "catastrophic"), Zubir Ahmed.
